prose: Dylan Saccoccio returns to InnerVerse to share the sacred symbolism of the supreme generative power laid up in the mythos of the Ark and the flood hero it bears. Joining us is Mario Garza, to add further observations as we explore the numerous accounts of savior-ships found across countless cultures of all ages, and what hints they may provide to our understanding of an ancient and forgotten universal empire.
ext: The over-sized extension (1.5+ hours) is where we really hit our stride, hammering the final nails into that starry coffin that is also a boat, seed, earth, etc...
music: InnerVerse intro theme by Conspiracy Music Guru
